description.value:
Duration constant

Your called command may target any number of allies who can hear and understand you, rather than one, but each ally may still borrow your Standing only once per round and only for a single action. Commanding more than four allies at once costs you an additional action.

cinderfall.incomplete: Lets the called command target any number of allies rather than one; commanding more than four costs an extra action. Same "nothing to extend" gap as cadre-ascendant/second-order -- the base called-command mechanic carries no rule element to widen.
